problem: Same customer_id twice with a different phone and area
proposed_rule: Keep the most recent row per customer_id; log the conflict

problem: signup_date in the future
proposed_rule: signup_date must be <= run date

problem: Email is 'N/A', missing the @ or missing the domain suffix
proposed_rule: Load the customer, set email_valid = false, mask as usual

problem: loyalty_tier casing variants (BRONZE, bronze, SILVER)
proposed_rule: Title case before use so tiers group correctly

problem: Phone is not a 10 digit Indian mobile number
proposed_rule: Load the customer, set phone_valid = false

problem: City blank
proposed_rule: Default to Bengaluru (single city operation) and flag

problem: Pincode contains letters (5600XX)
proposed_rule: Load, flag; do not use for geo rollups

problem: Same order_id appears more than once (identical rows)
proposed_rule: Keep first row per order_id; drop later copies before loading

problem: customer_id is blank
proposed_rule: customer_id must be present and non blank

problem: order_amount does not equal quantity x unit_price x (1 - discount/100)
proposed_rule: Recompute and compare to 2 decimals; quarantine on mismatch

problem: quantity is zero or negative
proposed_rule: quantity must be > 0; a return is a status, not a negative quantity

problem: product_id not present in products.csv
proposed_rule: product_id must exist in the product catalogue

problem: DELIVERED order has no delivery_minutes
proposed_rule: DELIVERED implies a delivery time; reject if blank

problem: order_ts is dated after the extract date
proposed_rule: order_ts must be <= run date

problem: order_ts is blank, 'N/A', an impossible date (31/09) or a non ISO format
proposed_rule: order_ts must parse as a real timestamp

problem: delivery_minutes of 480, 900 or 1440 (hours recorded as minutes)
proposed_rule: delivery_minutes must be <= 120 for the 10 minute promise KPI

problem: store_id not present in stores.csv
proposed_rule: store_id must exist in the store master

problem: order_status outside DELIVERED / CANCELLED / RETURNED
proposed_rule: Uppercase and trim, then reject anything outside the allowed list

problem: discount_pct above 100
proposed_rule: discount_pct must be between 0 and 100

problem: payment_mode casing or spelling variants (upi, CARD, cod, Cashh, trailing space)
proposed_rule: Map via lookup to the canonical four values; load the row

problem: order_status recorded in lowercase ('delivered')
proposed_rule: Trim and upper-case before validating; the row itself is fine

problem: Rows restate September orders with a new status (DELIVERED to RETURNED)
proposed_rule: MERGE on order_id so status is updated, not appended

problem: SUCCESS payment amount differs from the order amount
proposed_rule: Write to the reconciliation table with reason AMOUNT_MISMATCH

problem: SUCCESS payment with zero or negative amount_paid
proposed_rule: A SUCCESS payment must be > 0

problem: Same payment_id and gateway_ref ingested twice
proposed_rule: Deduplicate on payment_id before reconciliation

problem: Payment references an order_id that does not exist in orders.csv
proposed_rule: Route to reconciliation as PAYMENT_WITHOUT_ORDER, never into revenue

problem: gateway_ref blank (mostly Cash on Delivery, but also some card and UPI rows)
proposed_rule: Load the row; flag blanks so finance can chase the gateway

problem: payment_mode casing or spelling variants
proposed_rule: Map to canonical values before grouping revenue by mode

problem: cost_price above mrp, which would make every sale loss making
proposed_rule: cost_price must be <= mrp

problem: Same product_id twice, second row suffixed '(old)' with a different mrp
proposed_rule: Keep the current row, drop the '(old)' version, or model as SCD2

problem: Category blank, so margin by category loses these products
proposed_rule: Category must be present; derive from sub_category if agreed with merchandising

problem: mrp is negative
proposed_rule: mrp must be > 0

problem: Zone blank, so this store falls out of every zone rollup
proposed_rule: Zone must be present; BTM Layout is South per the store master owner

problem: capacity_orders_per_day is 0, which breaks any utilisation metric
proposed_rule: Capacity must be > 0; confirm the real figure with ops
